{c_label}Spirit Cost:{/c} {c_resource}{Resource Cost}{/c} per period
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}[{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]{/c}
{/if}Conjure a growing lightning storm that deals {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE}{/c} damage per strike. The number of strikes increases the longer the storm is channeled, up to a maximum of {c_number}[((SF_14*SF_12) + (Mod.Upgrade2 ? SF_21 : 0) + (Mod.UpgradeA ? SF_28 : 0))]{/c} strikes at once. {c_important}Lightning Storm{/c} may grow up to {c_number}[SF_14]{/c} times.

The size of your {c_important}Lightning Storm{/c} is preserved for {c_number}[SF_10 + (Mod.Upgrade4 ? SF_24 : 0)]{/c} seconds after channeling.
{c_important}Lightning Storm{/c} may grow {c_number}[SF_29]{/c} additional time and each periodic gains {c_number}[SF_28]{/c} additional strikes.

All of your Lightning Strikes are combined into one powerful attack at the targeted location. Size is increased by {c_number}[SF_30*100|%|]{/c} and damage is increased by {c_number}[SF_31*100|x%|]{/c} per Lightning Strike.

{c_important}Lightning Storm{/c} can be toggled passively and travels with you. {c_important}Lightning Storm{/c} deals {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_UPGRADEC_DAMAGE}{/c} damage and will be maintained as long as you have enough Spirit.  Cast {c_important}Lightning Storm{/c} again to cancel this effect.
{c_important}Lightning Storm's{/c} gains {c_number}[SF_17*100|x%|]{/c} bonus damage. This bonus is increased to {c_number}[SF_18*100|x%|]{/c} if the target is {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}.

Gain {c_number}[SF_21]{/c} additional Lightning Strike. Furthermore, each stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} also grants {c_number}[SF_22]{/c} additional Lightning Strike, up to a maximum of {c_number}[SF_20]{/c} additional strikes.
{c_important}Lightning Storm{/c} always grows from a baseline of {c_number}[SF_23]{/c} strikes.

The size of your {c_important}Lightning Storm{/c} is preserved for an additional {c_number}[SF_24]{/c} seconds after channeling. In addition, you gain a {c_number}[SF_25*100|x%|]{/c} Movement Speed bonus while {c_important}Lightning Storm's{/c} size is preserved.
